subject: HelixPay: request for 'golden snapshot' extract + RPO sampling plan
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@helixpay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up — golden snapshot + RPO sampling for US-WEST-2

Priya — thanks for the quick sync earlier. HelixPay's security team needs two items to close the SIG/CAIQ evidence: a reproducible KV snapshot (what we call a "golden snapshot") showing the last-consistent-state for a sample tenant, and a short RPO sampling plan that demonstrates how you measure/verify RPO across our primary region (us-west-2).

Can you provide: 
- a short playbook (steps we can follow) to request and verify a golden snapshot for one production tenant (non-sensitive sample)
- one representative KV export from your test cluster that demonstrates timestamped keys and the export manifest (can be redacted)
- an RPO sampling manifest describing the sampling windows, how you select checkpoints, and a simple sample CSV with timestamps we can inspect

Timeline: our auditors are closing next week — can we get initial artifacts by EOD Tue (2027-03-15)? If that's tight, earliest feasible date works. We'll also need a 30-minute walkthrough where your ops team can demonstrate the snapshot extraction and a restore dry-run to our security witness.

I've attached the SIG questionnaire sections that reference this.

Attachments: helix_sig_q.pdf (excerpt)

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Security Program Lead, HelixPay
alex.turner@helixpay.com
--
HelixPay Inc.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@helixpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — golden snapshot + RPO sampling for US-WEST-2

Alex — thanks, we can do this. Quick clarifications so we scope exactly what you'll review: 
1) By "golden snapshot" you mean a consistent KV export plus the manifest showing sequence numbers and wall-clock timestamps, correct?
2) For the sample tenant: you prefer a synthetic/redacted dataset from our staging run or a scrubbed production tenant export? We recommend staged sample to avoid any PII handling.
3) Witness: do you want a live Zoom demo with remote access or a stepped recording plus a short live Q&A?

Plan proposal (high level) — we can: 
- Deliver a playbook (PDF) with the extraction steps and security checks.
- Provide a redacted KV export (CSV manifest + small data sample) from a recent test-run.
- Produce an RPO sampling manifest (CSV) with three sample checkpoints and time offsets showing how we compute RPO.
- Schedule a 30-minute live restore dry-run with ops on Tue 2027-03-16 or Wed 2027-03-17; if you need earlier, we can aim for Mon 03-15 morning PST but will need an ops on-call handoff.

I'm attaching our internal extraction playbook and a draft CSV manifest for RPO sampling so you can confirm format. We'll redact any identifying fields. If that looks OK, we'll lock in the walkthrough time.

Attachments: redwood_golden_snapshot_instructions.pdf

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — golden snapshot + RPO sampling for US-WEST-2

Looping in the ops checklist and proposed timeline. Priya — I'll own extraction and the live dry-run. Karthik — can you provide the scrubbed sample export from our staging run and confirm retention metadata?

Deliverables we'll send to HelixPay by EOD Mon 2027-03-15 (per Alex's ask):
- Playbook PDF (extraction steps, permissions, checks) — will include the exact CLI commands and IAM role used
- Redacted KV export manifest (rpo_sampling_manifest.csv) with three timestamps and sequence IDs
- Small sample payload file demonstrating key/timestamp formatting (no PII)
- Calendar invite (witness-invite.ics) for a 30-minute window; propose Tue 2027-03-16 09:00-09:30 PT as default

Ops notes: 
- We'll generate the snapshot from staging in a read-only mode; extraction will be performed by an ops engineer (on-call rotation attached) and verified against our internal checkpoint printer.
- Restore dry-run will use ephemeral infra in us-west-2 and a single-tenant namespace to keep it lightweight — full restore not performed.

Attachments: rpo_sampling_manifest.csv, witness-invite.ics

Marissa Cole
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@helixpay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, security@helixpay.com <security@helixpay.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — golden snapshot + RPO sampling for US-WEST-2

Thanks — this plan looks good. We prefer the staging/redacted approach. Please go ahead with the artifacts by Mon EOD and lock in Tue 09:00 PT for the walkthrough (witness: Priya Shah from HelixPay security will join).

Two quick asks for the artifacts themselves: 
- In the CSV manifest, include a short column that maps sequence IDs to wall-clock UTC timestamps.
- For the playbook, flag any required temporary IAM permissions we will need to grant if we ever request a snapshot on our own (document as minimal-scope roles).

I'll expect the Drive link or zipped artifacts in your reply on Mon; we'll confirm the witness list after that. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Alex Turner
Security Program Lead, HelixPay
alex.turner@helixpay.com
